name: Himeno Shirayuki
source:
The younger twin sister. The transfer student and the second girl who becomes the protagonist's girlfriend. The complete opposite of Niki—put nicely, she's laid-back; put bluntly, she's gloomy.

I feel like someone's watching me... and when I turn around, it's definitely Shirayuki. She stalks the protagonist, secretly researching his preferences.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#sirayuki]official site[/url]]
